posts.text:
I stopped editing short videos and started writing them.

motionkit is a small open-source kit: a film is an HTML page plus one function, render(t), that sets every property from the time. Headless Chromium steps through it frame by frame and ffmpeg encodes it.

What that buys you:
- Scrubbing and exports are frame-exact
- The voiceover's word times drive cuts, sound effects and captions
- One brief renders every hook and ad variant

Free: github.com/Gonzolt/motionkit

thread: I stopped editing short videos and started writing them. A film is an HTML page plus render(t). Every frame is a function of time.
The voiceover's word times are the timeline: they cut the picture, place the sound effects and time the captions. Re-record the voice and everything re-times.
26 effects, word-synced captions, carousels and ad variants from one brief. Free and open source: github.com/Gonzolt/motionkit
